---
title: facet-grid
subtitle: "Grid facets: panels on a row x col grid from two discrete variables."
category: Facets
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Either `rows` or `cols` may be `none`, but not both. Only shared scales
are supported in v1.

## Usage

```typst
facet-grid(
  rows: none,
  cols: none,
  scales: "fixed",
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | `none` | Name of the discrete column driving panel rows, or `none`. |
| `cols` | `none` | Name of the discrete column driving panel columns, or `none`. |
| `scales` | `"fixed"` | Scale policy. Only `"fixed"` is supported in v1. |

## Returns

Facet dictionary consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/facet-grid-1.svg"
//| width: 12cm
//| height: 7cm
#let d = ()
#for sp in ("a", "b") {
  for sex in ("F", "M") {
    for i in range(0, 5) {
      d.push((sp: sp, sex: sex, x: i, y: i + 1))
    }
  }
}
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 2pt),),
  facet: facet-grid(rows: "sex", cols: "sp"),
)
```

## See also

[`facet-wrap`](facet-wrap.qmd), [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).
